sections.changelog:
1.72.5

  • Guide schema module: cornerstone guide posts get FAQPage JSON-LD (AEO/AI answer surfaces) printed in wp_head, reciprocal hreflang between HE/EN siblings, and correct html lang on English guides. Reusable via post meta for every future guide.

1.72.4

  • The RFP document is real: every buy-flow request generates a branded, printable, tokenized document (server-side facts only) with the unit, the configuration, matched advisors from the professionals directory, a status timeline and full disclaimers. Linked from the done screen, stored on the lead for the owner.

1.72.3

  • Buy-flow v1 on every apartment panel: "build me an offer" - finish level, advisor and designer add-ons (never pre-checked), 2-field WhatsApp-first capture with consent, honest staged dispatch animation and a what-happens-next timeline. Posts structured RFP context into the lead system. Full 5-language support.

1.72.2

  • The article weaver: same words, magazine packaging - chapter frames with numbered heads and asset thumbs, jump TOC pills, localized labels (he/en/fr/ru/ar). Nothing removed, SEO hierarchy untouched.
  • Default interior: units without their own interior show the project generic interior with an honest label in the page language.
  • wptexturize disabled: WordPress was converting hyphens to en/em dashes at render, re-violating the no-long-dashes law on clean content.

1.72.1

  • View cone on the map: selecting an apartment draws a terracotta cone on the building pin pointing where that apartment looks, rotating with the terrain.
  • Hero/poster split: the marketing hero (project_3d_image) carries the page hero and the premium-catalog card; the 3D model render stays the loading poster so the crossfade remains seamless.
  • Premium catalog cards carry a small 3D badge thumb of the model.

1.72.0

  • ONE map doctrine: the unified POI map (prices, education, transit, shopping, health, future plans, 3D, satellite) now sits directly under the 3D theater; the engine adopts it after render and retires its own plain map (the old DOMContentLoaded move raced the engine and left two maps live).
  • Model-to-map sync: orbiting the 3D building turns the map bearing to match (user gestures only), and selecting an apartment turns the map to face the apartment view direction.
  • Map section fully localized (he/en/fr/ru/ar) - no Hebrew chips on foreign pages.
  • Hebrew compass names in unit meta now map to per-language labels (dir badge leak fixed).
